title: Update of data through 2023
description:
Update of data through 2023 and fix code that was generating warnings because it relied on deprecated function names.

Note that this changes the required minimum for R to 3.5 since it has updated rda files.

title: Updated data to most recent available
description: Mostly a straightforward update to the most recent data. I found a better source of births data after 1959, so switched to using that.

title: Add 2018-2020 data + Update depreciated code
description:
This PR:

+ Adds data for 2018, 2019 and 2020 to `lifetables`, `births`, `babynames` and `names`
+ Updated `data-raw` scripts to both incorporate new data and remove depreciated code
+ Updated snapshot tests to reflect new data
+ Bumped version from `1.0.1` to `1.1.1`
+ Updated documentation (`R/data.R`, `NEWS.md`, `README.md`) to reflect newly added data

When testing on a local build all `revdep` and `testthat` checks and tests passed.

title: Added recent data to the babynames project
description:
Hi Hadley,

I have updated your `babynames` project to include recent information related to births and the life tables. The changes are summarized as follows:

- `data-raw/births.R`: I added the number of total births from 2018 (which appears to be the most recent data available since final values for 2019 have not yet been reported).
- `data-raw/applicants.R`: This was updated to get the [html source page](www.ssa.gov/oact/babynames/numberUSbirths.html), which appears to have been changed since the last time this project was updated.
- `data-raw/lifetables.R`: I have updated this to now include the year 2020.

I have added a few small changes for clarity and also ran the scripts to ensure that the `.csv` and `.rda` files corresponding to the changed `.R` files were also updated. I hope you find these of use. Thanks.

Best Regards,

Tyler Paxman

title: Update Data Through 2017
description:
Closes #25 .  Updates all available data sources through 2017.

Including, but not limited to the following changes:
1. Manual extraction of birth data 2016 - 2017
2. Updating to use a new URL for the XLS that is the source of birth counts 1909 - 2001.
3. Using {usethis} where appropriate.
4. Using {rvest} and {xml2} in the place of {XML}.
5. Eliminating vestigial data in the /data directory.
